name: KiwiUp Payment & Shipping Rules for WooCommerce
author: kiwiup

sections.description:
KiwiUp Payment & Shipping Rules lets you create exclusion rules to restrict payment gateways, shipping methods, and shipping countries/states at checkout using conditional logic.

Features

  • Restrict shipping methods and payment gateways using conditional logic
  • Disable or Hide Shipping Methods
  • Disable or Hide Payment Gateways
  • Create Shipping Country and State Restrictions
  • Disable/Hide Shipping Methods by
    Per product, category, shipping class, weight, item quantity, or cart total.
  • Global Restrictions
  • Per Product Restrictions
  • Tested with WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 10.8

PREMIUM FEATURES

  • ONE TIME PAYMENT with FREE PREMIUM support
  • LIFETIME FREE UPDATES (future compatibility proof)
  • UNLIMITED ROW (Shipping Method Restriction)
  • UNLIMITED ROW (Payment Gateway Restriction)
  • UNLIMITED ROW (Shipping Countries & States Restriction)
  • RESTRICT BY Cart Total, Item Count, Weight, Coupon, Shipping Class, Category, Currency, Country, Backorder, Billing Country, Customer Role, Product on Subscription, Membership Plan, Recurring Package etc.
  • Compatible with the latest WooCommerce
  • 24/7 Chat Support

You can get the PRO Version here!

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Configure rules under WooCommerce → Settings → Restrictions.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I restrict payment methods based on cart total?

Yes. You can create rules with conditions such as cart total, order total, product categories, customer role, shipping country, and more.

Can I set restrictions per product?

Yes. Edit a product and open the Restrictions tab under Product Data to add product-level rules. You can also disable all product-level rules globally from the plugin settings.

Does the free version include all restriction types?

Yes. The free version includes payment gateway, shipping method, and shipping country restrictions with conditional logic. Multiple rules of the same type require the PRO version.

Does this plugin collect personal data?

No. KiwiUp Payment & Shipping Rules does not collect, store, or share personal data. It uses WooCommerce checkout data only to evaluate your configured rules.
